observations: Photo 0 shows a front-loading washing machine with a white body and a large circular door. The brand name 'KENWOOD' is visible on the top left of the control panel.
The machine is placed on a wooden stand with wheels, and there are tangled cables on the floor around it.
Photo 1 shows a different front-loading washing machine, also white, with the brand name 'SIEMENS' clearly visible on the top left of the control panel.
Photo 1 has tools and parts on top of the machine, including a blue cable, a plastic-wrapped object, and a purple bag.
Both photos have a watermark 'MOSCO TECHNICAL SERV' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
The machine in photo 1 has a 'CAITRALLASS' label near the door and a blue circular sticker on the right side of the door.
The control panels of both machines have dials and digital displays, but no model numbers are clearly readable.
